about: The test classes `node evals/scripts/run_tests.mjs --fast` leaves out: the property sweeps, which compile or compose a page many times over a grid of forms, fixtures or settings, and the end-to-end authoring runs, which run author-deck.mjs as an author does. Each took over ~4.5 s of a worker when listed, and together most of the suite's CPU time. --fast is for iterating; the full suite (no flag) runs them too, and runs once before a commit or push. A key is a class (`module.Class`) or a whole module; tests/test_run_tests.py fails on a key that names nothing the runner schedules. Not to be confused with --slow, which adds the opt-in LibreOffice tests.
